title: Reported Muscat grievance visits by Dhofar sheikhs and local notables (date and gathering status unverified)
location: Muscat is mentioned as a destination; the precise meeting site is not stated.

threshold_50_evidence: Not established. The opinion gives no attendance number and does not establish a public assembly; the number of named social roles is not a crowd estimate.

notes: This is a follow-up lead, not a verified protest. The source is an opinion column, not direct participant testimony.
